description: This file defines the 'TalkModeRuntime' actor responsible for voice recognition, speech synthesis, and handling of text-to-speech within the application's talk mode. It manages audio input, recognition tasks, speech output, and configuration fetching, implementing complex speech interaction workflows.

classes.name: RMSMeter
classes.description: A thread-safe utility class for measuring the RMS audio level.

classes.name: RecognitionUpdate
classes.description: A struct encapsulating updates from the speech recognition process.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the talk mode runtime, starting or stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes the speech recognition process, managing recognition sessions and UI states.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Initializes and starts a speech recognition session.

methods.name: stopRecognition
methods.description: Cancels and clears current recognition tasks and requests.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Processes recognition updates, managing transcript states and recognizing speech confidence.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Begins monitoring for silence to finalize speech input.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if speech input has been silent for the configured duration and finalizes transcription.

methods.name: finalizeTranscript
methods.description: Finalizes and processes the transcribed text, triggering responses or further processing.

methods.name: sendAndSpeak
methods.description: Sends the user's transcript to the backend and then plays the assistant's response.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs the prompt message for sending based on the transcript and interruptions.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Handles text-to-speech synthesis and playback for assistant responses.

methods.name: playRemoteStream
methods.description: Plays streaming TTS audio from a remote source, handling fallback formats.

methods.name: playSystemVoice
methods.description: Uses the system TTS engine to speak text when external TTS fails or is not configured.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Reloads configuration settings for voice, model, and output format.

methods.name: resolveVoiceId
methods.description: Resolves the preferred voice ID, fetching defaults if necessary.

methods.name: noteAudioLevel
methods.description: Updates RMS noise floor and detects speech energy levels.

methods.name: shouldInterrupt
methods.description: Determines whether ongoing recognition should be interrupted based on confidence and energy.
